name: tank-tussle
description: Tank Tussle, an artillery duel game — NestJS server, React web client, React Native app, shared TypeScript game engine

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @tank-tussle/game-core && npm run build -w @tank-tussle/protocol && npm run build -w @tank-tussle/client-core
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @tank-tussle/server && npm run build -w @tank-tussle/client
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n core,protocol,client-core,server,client -c gray,gray,gray,blue,magenta "npm run build -w @tank-tussle/game-core -- --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "npm run build -w @tank-tussle/protocol -- --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "npm run build -w @tank-tussle/client-core -- --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "npm run dev -w @tank-tussle/server" "npm run dev -w @tank-tussle/client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @tank-tussle/client && npm run sync -w @tank-tussle/mobile
scripts.mobile:ios: npm run mobile:sync && npm run ios -w @tank-tussle/mobile
scripts.mobile:android: npm run mobile:sync && npm run android -w @tank-tussle/mobile
scripts.native:ios: npm run build:packages && npm run ios -w @tank-tussle/native
scripts.native:android: npm run build:packages && npm run android -w @tank-tussle/native
